criteria.criterion: Planners and coordinator use named payload types for every supported direction/action pair; construction rejects missing, extra critical, or wrong-action fields before effects. Evidence: mutation_payloads.py typed union + __post_init__ validation; tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_mutation_payloads.py and test_payload_shadow_corpus.py reject scenarios.

The shadow comparator executes no Jira transport or ticket-store write, proven with failing spies on every effect seam. Evidence: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_payload_shadow_effect_spies.py (effect_spies fixture + test_spies_actually_fire_on_a_leaky_stub self-check + full-corpus/dataclass-construction never-trips tests).

The corpus covers create/update/delete/probe/conflict, inbound-only actions, links/comments/labels/status/parent/assignee/binding fields, duplicate and malformed inputs, suppression/follow-ons, ambiguous outcomes, retry exhaustion, and multi-project routing. Evidence: tests/fixtures/reconciler/payload_corpus/v1/.

Replaying the same corpus is deterministic and idempotent; corpus version/provenance and normalization rules are explicit. Evidence: tests/fixtures/reconciler/payload_corpus/README.md plus the versioned v1/ directory; test_payload_shadow_corpus.py asserts deterministic replay.

Legacy and typed traces have zero unexplained differences. Each intentional delta has a named test, rationale, and approval recorded on the ticket. Evidence: the 4 approved intentional deltas documented in this ticket's own comment thread, each backed by a named expect:"reject" scenario in test_payload_shadow_corpus.py.

Verified-fake Jira Cloud and Data Center adapter contract tests pass without selecting a live backend. Evidence: the pre-existing verified-fake adapter contract suite (reused per this story's Approach) is green in the full local suite run and in CI (Gerrit change 2436, Verified +1).

Production continues to use the pre-cutover route in this story: the story's diff touches no production dispatch entry point (typed_dispatch._LEAVES, batch_dispatch._mutation_to_batch_dict, applier.apply(), or any producer in differ.py / outbound_mutation_builders.py / run_differs.py / outbound_pass.py / binding_walk.py / invariants.py) — verified by an explicit route-census check — and no module introduced by this story is later relied upon as a permanent production write path. Evidence: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_payload_shadow_route_census.py.
